name: Un'Goro Crater
summary: Un'Goro Crater draws travelers into a lush basin between the deserts of Tanaris and Silithus. Dinosaurs roam beneath a central volcano, among living elementals and ancient Titan relics. Colored power crystals lie across the basin, though their origins remain a mystery.

sections.title: The God Lands
sections.body: Ancient night elf records of the War of the Shifting Sands say the Qiraji were turned back at Un'Goro Crater's edges. In their tongue, they called this place the 'God Lands.' Scholars believe the Titans may have used the caldera as a testing ground or dwelling while shaping Kalimdor. Stone pylons rise along the ridges and hum with energy. Blue, red, green, and yellow crystals emerge from the primeval earth.

sections.title: A Savage Ecosystem
sections.body: Un'Goro has no cities, towns, or native humanoid societies. Life thrives here in a wild, primeval state. Devilsaurs stalk the flats of Terror Run, bloodpetals lash out in the marshlands, and oozes creep across the tar pits of Lakkari. At the crater's heart, Fire Plume Ridge is an active volcano filled with hostile fire elementals led by Blazerunner. Explorers and skinners seek its natural wealth, including devilsaur hides, if they can survive the food chain.

sections.title: Marshal's Refuge
sections.body:
Marshal's Refuge, an elevated camp in the northern cliffs, holds nearly all of Un'Goro's settled presence. Williden Marshal led scientists, naturalists, and fortune seekers here to catalogue the basin's treasures.

Monstrous wildlife battered the expedition and drove its members to high ground. The refuge remains an embattled staging ground for travelers studying the mysterious power crystals, mapping volcanic activity, and watching silithid swarms encroach through the southern ridges.

faq.q: How do you get into Un'Goro Crater?
faq.answer: Natural ramps lead down the crater walls. One comes from southwestern Tanaris near Thistleshrub Valley, and another from northeastern Silithus. Without magical aid, a leap from the cliffs is fatal. Marshal's Refuge in the north has flight connections to Gadgetzan and Cenarion Hold.

faq.q: What are the colored power crystals used for?
aliases: red blue green yellow crystals ungoro
faq.answer: Red, blue, green, and yellow Power Crystals lie across the jungle floor. Gnome researcher J.D. Collie at Marshal's Refuge can guide explorers in deciphering how to use them at the Northern, Eastern, and Western Pylons. Combine certain colors at the right pylons to harness latent Titan energies and make defensive or restorative charms.

faq.q: Why is Un'Goro lush despite being surrounded by deserts?
faq.answer: Scholars believe the Titans, who shaped the world, made Un'Goro's unnatural vibrancy. Titanic conduits, warmth from Fire Plume Ridge, and ancient ley energy nourish its isolated, fast-growing ecosystem. It resists the arid conditions of neighboring Tanaris and Silithus.

faq.q: Why did the Qiraji call this place the 'God Lands'?
faq.answer: Tablets translated from the War of the Shifting Sands say the insect swarms halted at Un'Goro's threshold. In their tongue, they called it the 'God Lands.' Geologist Larksbane, who translated the account, connects the name to theories that the Titans once dwelt in the crater and wonders whether Aman'Thul himself watched over it.

faq.q: What is Un'Goro Soil used for?
faq.answer: Rich, potent dirt lies across the crater basin. Pair harvested soil with Tharlendris seeds in an Evergreen Pouch to grow Morrowgrain, a mystical herb intensely sought by researchers in Thunder Bluff, Darnassus, and the Cenarion Circle.

faq.q: Are there any humanoid settlements or dungeons here?
faq.answer: Un'Goro Crater has the Shaper's Terrace, for those around 58 to 60, but no indigenous humanoid societies. Marshal's Refuge, a small expedition outpost on the northern rim, is the only lasting settlement. Aside from isolated hermit hunters or lost explorers, the caldera is entirely wild.

angles.text: The basin's rich moisture lets Blindweed, Dreamfoil, and Golden Sansam flourish alongside Firebloom on the volcano's slopes. Few places in Kalimdor have all four growing together.
Mithril Deposits and Rich Thorium Veins are dense along the crater walls and the crags of Fire Plume Ridge. Un'Goro is a premier destination for high-end ore.

As a druid, you can study Un'Goro's isolated ecosystem with the Cenarion Circle and harvest its rich soil to grow Morrowgrain. The Circle seeks to understand the pure, untamed life force that sustains the caldera.

As an Alliance naturalist, you can gather with Williden Marshal and J.D. Collie at Marshal's Refuge. Alliance naturalists race to decipher the Titan pylons while protecting Darnassus researchers who collect soil samples.
As a Horde adventurer, you can come through Tanaris to test your prowess against legendary devilsaurs. You can also help Thunder Bluff herbalists cultivate Morrowgrain from Un'Goro's primeval dirt.
